mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the applicant's country of residence

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the applicant's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille where applicable; otherwise consular legalization by Vanuatu High Commission or Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Beneficial ownership and senior management declaration form (VFSC IC-BO1)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through the licensed registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Internal custody with registered agent; no apostille required unless the declaration is individually notarized

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, OFAC SDN and Sectoral Sanctions, EU Consolidated Financial Sanctions, HM Treasury Consolidated List, and the VFSC disqualified-control list. Any politically exposed person (PEP), immediate family member, or close associate requiring enhanced due diligence must provide source of wealth and source of funds evidence, with senior management approval threshold of the licensed agent for acceptance.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) International Company Name Reservation and Registration Online Portal (eRegistry)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: Company names must be submitted in Latin script (English/French); non-Latin script names must be transliterated or romanized when filing the name reservation. The name must include a corporate suffix such as Limited, Ltd., Corporation, Corp., Incorporated, Inc., or equivalent and must not be misleading or contrary to public policy.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Group (where misleading or implying a conglomerate)
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: A name rejection notice will be served electronically by VFSC to the licensed registered agent. The applicant may file a written administrative appeal within 14 calendar days from the date of the rejection notice, accompanied by a legal cover letter addressing the grounds for refusal and, if relevant, evidence of ministerial approval for a sensitive token. VFSC shall render a decision in writing within 7 business days of receipt. Where the appeal is successful, the reserved name is reinstated for the remaining 30-day reservation period; where unsuccessful, the reservation fee is forfeited and the applicant may propose a fresh name for a new reservation.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Virtual office is permissible for this low-risk online retail company provided that the company maintains a physical registered office in Vanuatu at the office of a licensed registered agent, a dedicated email address, and an acceptance of service clause in the engagement agreement. Day-to-day operations may be entirely remote, but the registered agent must be able to receive and respond to regulatory notices on the company's behalf.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low: estimated at 2-4% annual probability for a non-licensed, non-financial e-commerce retail company; VFSC and the Vanuatu Financial Intelligence Unit nonetheless retain the right to conduct unannounced physical verifications at the registered office.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act, Cap 222 (Vanuatu), ss. 7 (incorporation), 9 (memorandum), 13 (registered office), 17 (directors), 24 (secretary)
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) – International Companies Registry
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation, together with the Memorandum and Articles of Association and consent documents
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No minimum paid-up capital requirement. Share capital may be issued in any currency, and shares may be with or without par value. No escrow account obligation for foreign investors.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED that the subscribers to the Memorandum and Articles of Association adopt the incorporation of the Company as an International Company under Cap 222. RESOLVED FURTHER that 1,000 no-par ordinary shares at USD 1.00 each be issued to the founding subscriber for cash. RESOLVED FURTHER that the registered office be at Level 2, Bougainville Centre, Port Vila, Vanuatu, under custody of the licensed agent, and that this address be filed with the Registrar. RESOLVED FINALLY that [Director A] and [Director B] be appointed as directors, and [Secretary] be appointed as secretary, with full powers to open bank accounts, execute contracts, and undertake all administrative acts.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Engage licensed registered agent and prepare incorporation documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC – International Companies Registry (via approved registered agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Appoint a VFSC-licensed registered agent who will draft the Memorandum and Articles of Association, obtain subscriber signatures, and prepare Form IC-1 together with consent-to-act forms. The agent submits the package electronically through the VFSC portal after verifying due diligence.
required_dossiers: Memorandum and Articles of Association (drafted)
Form IC-1 Application for Incorporation
Consent to act as director (Form IC-3)
Consent to act as registered agent
Certified copies of directors' and shareholders' passports
Proof of residential address of directors/shareholders
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar issues a query or deficiency letter, the registered agent must respond within 10 business days with the requested clarifications or amended documents. A rejected company name may be changed by filing a new Form IC-1 with the revised name without a new filing fee.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Pay incorporation fee and obtain Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent makes the statutory fee payment via the VFSC portal (bank transfer or card). Upon approval, VFSC issues the Certificate of Incorporation electronically, including the company number and incorporation date. The certificate is downloaded and delivered to the company in the form of a certified copy.
required_dossiers: Registered agent's payment confirmation
VFSC application reference number
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the certificate is not issued within the SLA, the agent submits a written status request to VFSC's Registration Unit; any procedural delays are cured by expedited escalation and, if necessary, re-submission of the fee receipt.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Establish registered office and appoint statutory officers
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: VFSC – Registered Agents and Trustees Licensing Unit
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Execute a registered agent agreement and confirm the physical location of the registered office (Level 2, Bougainville Centre, Port Vila). The registered agent files Form IC-2 (Notice of Registered Office) and the consent forms for directors and secretary with VFSC, if not already lodged at incorporation.
required_dossiers: Registered agent agreement
Form IC-2 Notice of Registered Office
Signed consent to act as director
Signed consent to act as secretary
Board resolution appointing officers (if different from incorporators)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If VFSC raises an objection to the registered office address (e.g., invalid lease), the agent must provide a lease or occupancy authorization letter from the premises owner within 7 business days and re-file Form IC-2.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Adopt first board resolutions and open bank accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Company directors and corporate secretary (with no further VFSC approval, but bank account opening requires the bank's own due diligence)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Hold a physical or virtual first board meeting (or adopt a unanimous written resolution) to ratify the incorporation, issue shares, approve the registered office, and delegate authority to open corporate bank accounts. The secretary then files the share allotment return and the annual return where required by the legislation. A Certificate of Tax Exemption may be voluntarily obtained from VFSC confirming the company's exempt status.
required_dossiers: Pro-forma first board resolution
Register of members
Share certificate(s)
Certificate of Incorporation
Certificate of Tax Exemption (optional but recommended)
Bank account opening forms
Identity and due diligence dossiers of the beneficial owner
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank rejects the account application due to incomplete CDD, provide additional notarized identity documents and a written explanation of the business model. If the Tax Exemption Certificate is withheld, submit a statutory declaration confirming no Vanuatu-sourced income and no local operations.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Department of Industry and Investment, Ministry of Trade, Tourism, Industry and Commerce (oversight only; no licence required for pure online retail)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Not applicable to an International Company conducting only cross-border e-commerce; a Municipal Business Licence from the Port Vila City Council is only needed if the company establishes a physical shop or warehouse in Vanuatu.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Vanuatu Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt – No EIA required for office-based online retail and storage of portable solar and battery equipment in a rented warehouse without manufacturing or industrial processes.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No liquid discharge or VOC emissions generated by the retail activity. If a warehouse is used, compliance with general waste disposal and battery recycling regulations (Waste Management Regulations Order No. 58 of 2021) applies; lithium batteries must be stored with a containment plan to prevent soil and groundwater contamination.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: A fire safety clearance from the Vanuatu Fire Services must be obtained for any office/warehouse that is occupied by employees. The premises must meet the National Building Code structural load requirements, including safe storage of batteries and solar panels. An occupational health and safety clearance must be obtained from the Department of Labour, covering first aid, electrical safety, and emergency evacuation procedures.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Revenue and Customs (VRC), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management, Port Vila, Vanuatu; official portal: https://www.vanuatucustoms.gov.vu (VAT registration, customs declarations, ASYCUDA World). Corporate registry and offshore licensing: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC), https://www.vfsc.vu. Business licensing (local activity only): Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA), https://www.investinvanuatu.vu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Vanuatu imposes no income tax and maintains no general national TIN. A foreign-owned Vanuatu International Company (IC) obtains its statutory identity exclusively from VFSC: (1) file Articles of Incorporation through a licensed registered agent; (2) obtain Certificate of Incorporation and VFSC company number; (3) appoint a resident registered agent and, if required, a local secretary; (4) register for VAT with VRC on the prescribed VAT Registration Form 001 only if the IC makes taxable supplies in Vanuatu or elects voluntary registration, thereby receiving a VRC VAT Identification Number; (5) no further tax registration is required for a non-resident IC whose management, sales, and operations are conducted entirely outside Vanuatu.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid-mismatch election exists because Vanuatu has no corporate income tax code. Statutory options relevant to the IC: (i) voluntary VAT registration under the Value Added Tax Act for persons below the VUV 5,000,000 threshold, enabling input credit recovery on domestic costs; (ii) election to zero-rate exported goods and offshore services where the IC is VAT-registered; (iii) continuation or redomiciliation into Vanuatu under the International Companies Act, permitting transfer of foreign incorporation with a Ministerial certificate; (iv) election to obtain a Ministerial Certificate of Exemption confirming the IC's statutory tax-immune status. Non-resident status for exchange-control and AML purposes is automatic for ICs that do not hold a Vanuatu domestic business licence.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the Value Added Tax Act 1998 (Cap 248), supplemented by Customs and Excise Duties on imported goods; no separate GST or sales-and-use tax system exists.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 5,000,000 annual value of taxable supplies made in Vanuatu (compulsory registration); voluntary registration is permitted below the threshold; a pure offshore IC with no Vanuatu domestic supply has no VAT registration nexus and remains outside the VAT net; imports entering Vanuatu are taxed at the border at 12.5% VAT plus applicable customs duty.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No electronic invoicing, real-time fiscal clearance, API tax-stamping, or B2B e-invoicing mandate is in force. Suppliers may issue paper or PDF VAT invoices containing prescribed particulars (supplier name and VAT ID, invoice date, description of supply, consideration, and VAT amount). Import and export declarations are processed electronically via the ASYCUDA World single-window customs clearance system, which requires electronic filing of the Customs Declaration (CUS/EXP and CUS/IMP forms) with supporting documentation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Exports of goods and offshore services qualify for 0% VAT where the goods are physically exported from Vanuatu within 28 days of supply (or a longer period approved by the Commissioner) and the supplier retains commercial evidence of export; services performed wholly outside Vanuatu or supplied to a non-resident, including the IC's cross-border online retail of portable solar generators and panels where title and risk pass to foreign consumers outside Vanuatu, are either zero-rated or entirely outside the scope of Vanuatu VAT. For the IC, the controlling conclusion is that no Vanuatu VAT charge arises on foreign sales, so no zero-rating claim is required in the ordinary course of the offshore e-commerce model.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World CUS/EXP form and exit certificate)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical removal from Vanuatu
Commercial Invoice or Sales Contract for the exported goods
Packing List and HS Classification Supporting Materials
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT credit advice evidencing receipt of foreign currency proceeds
Proof of Payment or Purchase Order from the offshore buyer
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: VRC audits zero-rated claims strictly and may reopen assessments within a standard three-year period, extended to ten years in cases of fraud or deliberate misstatement. Where export documentation is deficient, the Commissioner claws back VAT at 12.5% on the invoiced value, denies refunds, applies penalty interest, and imposes civil penalties of up to twice the tax evaded for wilful evasion; criminal proceedings may also be instituted for false declarations. For International Companies, substantiated involvement in fraudulent zero-rating or customs misdeclaration additionally triggers VFSC deregistration and forfeiture of the statutory tax-immune status, with directors and officers jointly and severally exposed to personal liability.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu maintains an exchange-control-light environment for non-resident International Companies. The Vatu (VUV) is the domestic legal tender and is not freely deliverable outside Vanuatu; practical convertibility occurs only through RBV-authorised commercial banks at commercial exchange rates. Current-account proceeds from cross-border e-commerce sales may be received in USD or another freely usable currency and converted to VUV without prior regulatory approval. Capital-account inflows such as share capital and shareholder loans are permitted for International Companies without a foreign-investment licence, provided the funds are remitted through the formal banking system from the shareholder's own account. Profit remittance and capital repatriation are not subject to Vanuatu withholding tax or exchange-control approval in the standard case, but each wire is independently screened by the receiving bank for sanctions, PEP status, source of funds and beneficial ownership transparency. The material treasury hurdle is therefore not regulatory convertibility but bank onboarding risk classification for a tax-exempt offshore vehicle; the IC should carry full commercial substance documentation in the source market to support account opening and routine settlement.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory export-proceeds surrender obligation is imposed on Vanuatu International Companies. There is no prescribed timeline for bringing export receipts into Vanuatu and no mandatory conversion ratio into VUV. The IC may lawfully maintain export proceeds in USD, EUR, CNY or other foreign currency in an authorised-dealer bank account. For AML and balance-of-payments data purposes, the bank will expect the IC to preserve the underlying sales invoices, payment-rail settlement reports from Stripe or Affirm, shipping or courier evidence, and a coherent record-to-report reconciliation trail. Failure to produce this trail may cause the bank to treat the IC as a shell and impose enhanced due diligence or account restriction.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: Medium-High as a secondary clearing layer, Low as the sole banking relationship. Legal constraints: a foreign electronic-money institution or digital bank is not licensed by the RBV to provide Vanuatu VUV-denominated payment services to a local IC, and many international EMIs decline Vanuatu-incorporated entities or impose enhanced customer due diligence. The IC may use an offshore EMI such as Wise Business or Airwallex to aggregate USD settlement proceeds from Stripe and Affirm and to make supplier disbursements, but the EMI will require a complete VFSC company file, registered-agent letter, UBO declaration, proof of genuine online retail operations, and a source-of-funds explanation. The EMI should never be used as the primary treasury account; a licensed Vanuatu bank account must remain the formal settlement and compliance anchor.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Physical presence is effectively mandatory for the target IC. Vanuatu banks expect at least one director and the ultimate beneficial owner, or a fully authorised signatory, to attend an in-person interview at a bank branch or before an approved Vanuatu professional intermediary. Pure remote video onboarding is not accepted as the sole identification mechanism for a tax-exempt International Company. If physical travel is not feasible, the IC's registered agent may introduce the shareholder under a professional-services letter, but the bank compliance committee retains the right to require a further face-to-face or notarised identity verification. Foreign notarisation must be accompanied by the standard documentary chain of corporate good standing and UBO disclosure.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore International Company with no physical presence, employees or corporate tax filing in Vanuatu
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, Register of Members, Register of Directors, Registered Agent letter confirming valid offshore IC status, board resolution approving the banking relationship, business plan for online portable solar power retail, e-commerce platform merchant IDs, supplier contracts, warehouse or 3PL agreements, and 24-month financial projections.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Ultimate beneficial owner is a non-resident individual and the shareholding structure uses nominee or professional directors
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Natural-person UBO passport copy, proof of residential address, source-of-wealth statement, signed UBO declaration, corporate ownership diagram, and a written explanation of why no nominee shareholder bears risk; the bank will favour direct natural-person shareholding over trustee or nominee layers.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Aggregated e-commerce settlement through Stripe and Affirm creates a perceived third-party funds transmission or transaction-laundering risk
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Stripe merchant agreement, Affirm BNPL merchant agreement, daily and monthly settlement statements, refund and chargeback policy, PCI DSS compliance attestation, customer invoices, shipping tracking records, and a treasury policy proving that all settlement funds are used only for the company's own trades and not for third-party payments.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Low or zero minimum capital and no statutory capital verification trigger a shell-company red flag
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Source bank statements from the shareholder's home jurisdiction, source-of-wealth letter, shareholder loan agreement or share subscription resolution, capital injection instruction letter, projected balance sheet, and bank-to-bank reference where available.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Vanuatu jurisdiction perception risk, including prior adverse FATF or tax-transparency mentions and lack of tax information exchange agreements
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: VFSC beneficial ownership register filing proof, official IC status letter, tax-residence and tax-exemption certificate if available, export/trade contract file evidencing that economic activity occurs in third-country markets, and audited or management accounts demonstrating real transactions rather than passive treasury movement.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: The initial capital injection must be routed over SWIFT MT103 or equivalent bank-to-bank transfer from the shareholder's personal or corporate bank account directly into a dedicated Capital Escrow Account opened in the name of the Vanuatu IC at the primary Vanuatu settlement bank. Crypto proceeds, cash deposits, third-party payments, and Stripe or Affirm revenue settlements must never be used as capital injections. The bank will require prior notification of at least 48 hours, a board resolution authorising the injection, share subscription documents, a source-of-funds declaration, and the recipient bank's standard purpose code for equity financing or capital contribution. The remitter name and ultimate beneficial owner must match the bank's approved KYC records exactly. After final bank compliance approval, the funds may be transferred from the Capital Escrow Account into the operational settlement account.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Supplier payments for solar panels and portable battery generators are effected primarily by SWIFT MT103 direct credit in USD or CNH where the beneficiary bank accepts offshore China settlement. For high-value trade contracts above USD 25,000, the IC may use an irrevocable commercial letter of credit issued at sight under ICC UCP600, supported by a clean on-board bill of lading, commercial invoice, packing list, and inspection certificate where the supplier requires documentary protection. Stripe and Affirm customer receivable settlements are swept to the IC's Vanuatu bank account and do not constitute trade disbursement rails. Small incidental supplier payments can be made through the bank's online foreign-currency disbursement function, but all disbursements must be supported by an underlying commercial invoice and treasury release instruction from two authorised signatories.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Onshore Vanuatu-vatu/US-dollar deliverable foreign exchange forward contracts with an RBV-authorised dealer, limited to committed export and import cash-flow exposure and a tenor not exceeding 12 months
Offshore non-deliverable forward (NDF) contracts on VUV/USD where the VUV component is non-deliverable outside Vanuatu, used strictly to hedge forecast net retail cash flows and settled in USD
USD/offshore-CNY deliverable forwards for settlement of supplier invoices originating in mainland China, provided the forward is documented by a purchase order and supplier proforma invoice
Cross-currency swaps between USD and VUV for balance-sheet hedging of long-term shareholder loans or supplier financing facilities, used only for risk management and not for speculative profit

FX option collars and plain-vanilla zero-premium structures on USD/CNY or USD/VUV to cap maximum conversion cost while retaining favourable exchange movements, subject to bank approval of the underlying trade exposure

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Government Fee Renewal and Registered Agent Continuation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) through a licensed registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary of incorporation date; payment due within 30 days after each anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment fee imposed under the International Companies (Fees) Regulations; continued non-payment beyond 90 days exposes the company to VFSC administrative strike-off after formal notice.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Confirmation of Directors, Shareholders and Registered Office
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC via registered agent records submitted at annual renewal
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Simultaneously with annual fee renewal, not later than 31 days after the incorporation anniversary
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inaccurate or stale agent records may trigger VFSC inspection, fines for the registered agent, and, if unresolved, revocation of the company's good standing certificate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC (non-public, accessible through the registered agent)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within 14 days of any change in beneficial ownership; annual consistency review at the anniversary confirmation date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain the beneficial ownership register is an offence under Vanuatu's beneficial ownership legislation, subject to fines and, in serious cases, VFSC deregistration action.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No mandatory audit for an International Company that does not carry on domestic business in Vanuatu; an audit obligation arises only if the company holds a domestic business licence, is a licensed financial institution, or is otherwise directed by VFSC or the registered agent's engagement terms.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: International Companies Act 1992 accounting-records requirements; IFRS is not statutorily imposed on tax-exempt International Companies, and local GAAP is not prescribed for offshore entities.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Shareholding transfers require a board resolution, immediate update of the Register of Members, and simultaneous confirmation to the registered agent for the beneficial ownership register. VFSC does not maintain a public UBO register; the annual renewal declaration confirms that the UBO register is accurate and up to date as at the anniversary date.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400–1,200 per year depending on provider; standard Vanuatu licensed agent corporate secretarial package typically USD 600–1,000.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not statutorily required for a standard International Company; optional accountant-reviewed financial statements USD 400–1,500; certified audit, if later required by a licence condition, USD 3,000–8,000.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 0.00% - Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, payroll tax, or dividend withholding tax; International Companies (ICs) are statutorily exempt under Section 128 of the International Companies Act [Cap 222].
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Absolute statutory exemption: no income tax holiday or preferential deduction is necessary. Exports of portable solar power goods are zero-rated for the 13% Value Added Tax; no social security contributions apply. The only recurring government costs are the annual VFSC compliance fee (approximately VUV 40,000) and the registered agent fee.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: International Company Annual Return and Annual Fee under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] (Sections 96-102); lodged with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) exclusively through a VFSC-licensed Registered Agent; VFSC Corporate Online Portal (iSupport) or paper lodgement.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual - due on each anniversary of the date of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual fee and return must be filed no later than the incorporation anniversary date; a 30-day grace window applies before penalty accrual; failure for 90 consecutive days triggers strike-off proceedings under Section 117 of the International Companies Act.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered Agent's Certificate of Compliance and identity verification statement.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The foreign beneficial owner executes a power of attorney; no Vanuatu tax identification number is required.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Company name and VFSC registration number.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Must match the VFSC register exactly; confirm no name caveat or strike-off order exists.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered office address in Port Vila (physical address, P.O. Box not acceptable).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The Registered Agent's office address is almost universally used for non-resident ICs.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Details of directors and company secretary (full legal name, nationality, residential address).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident natural persons or corporate directors are permitted; one director minimum; nominee services must be disclosed to the VFSC.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Authorised and issued share capital (no minimum capital requirement).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Standard authorised capital is USD 10,000; stamp duty is payable at incorporation only.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Declaration of non-local business (no business with Vanuatu residents, no land ownership, no domestic commercial activity).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Critical to preserve the 0% tax exemption: the e-commerce operation must exclude Vanuatu delivery addresses and Vanuatu-resident counterparties.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Economic Substance status declaration (whether the IC conducts a 'relevant activity' under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2020).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If distribution/procurement of solar equipment or intellectual-property licensing is in scope, local substance details (office, employees, expenditure) must be disclosed; a false nil declaration carries criminal exposure.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment surcharge of up to 20% of the annual fee; daily accrual after the 30-day grace period; strike-off from the register after 90 days; restoration fee plus arrears; director disqualification proceedings for chronic non-compliance.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Business Licence Renewal - Business Licence Act (No. 15 of 2010); Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, Municipal Councils (Port Vila or Luganville); paper or municipal online counter service.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual - licence valid for the calendar year (1 January to 31 December).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Renewal must be completed by 31 December of the preceding year for the following year; new licences must be obtained before commencement of business. A late-renewal window of 30 days exists with penalty; thereafter operation is unlawful.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Trading name and business owner details.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Not required for a purely offshore IC with no Vanuatu office, warehouse, employees, or local sales.
If a Vanuatu warehouse or local drop-shipping hub is established, the licence category 'Import/Export/Retail' applies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Description of commercial activity (ISIC 4791 online retail of portable power equipment).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The foreign IC must confirm the activity does not constitute domestic 'local business' reserved for Vanuatu companies.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Expected annual turnover for banding of the licence fee (VUV 0 - VUV 100 million+ bands).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Only Vanuatu-source turnover triggers the fee; offshore export revenue is excluded.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Operating without a licence: fine up to VUV 100,000 plus daily penalty of up to VUV 1,000 per day; forfeiture of unlawfully derived profit; revocation of any existing licence; prosecution of the registered agent if complicit.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VAT Return - Value Added Tax Act [Cap 216]; Department of Customs and Inland Revenue, VAT Section; monthly or approved quarterly electronic filing.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Monthly, or quarterly for small taxpayers where approved by the Commissioner.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: VAT return and payment must be lodged no later than 30 calendar days after the end of each VAT period.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Output tax on taxable local supplies (13% VAT).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Zero-rated for export supplies of solar generators and panels invoiced to non-residents; no output tax on offshore e-commerce sales.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Input tax credits on Vanuatu local purchases and import VAT.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No input VAT credits arise for an offshore IC because the supply chain is wholly external to Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Net VAT payable to the Commissioner.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Typically nil for a pure export retailer; registration is not triggered by non-resident turnover because the VAT registration threshold (VUV 4,000,000) applies only to Vanuatu taxable supplies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late payment: automatic 10% penalty plus continuing interest of 2% per month; late return: fine up to VUV 20,000; VAT evasion: penalty up to 200% of tax evaded and criminal prosecution with imprisonment up to 2 years.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0.00% - Vanuatu imposes no domestic withholding tax on dividends, distributions, or liquidation surplus paid by an International Company.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no comprehensive double taxation agreement (DTA) with any jurisdiction (including the People's Republic of China, Australia, the United States, or EU Member States). No treaty-relief application, tax-residency certificate, or limitation-of-benefits analysis is executed on the Vanuatu side. The IC distributes profits free of Vanuatu tax and without exchange-control approval. Beneficiaries must instead (i) obtain a Certificate of Good Standing from VFSC and an exemption letter from the Vanuatu Commissioner of Inland Revenue if a foreign tax credit is required at home; (ii) verify home-jurisdiction CFC and controlled-company rules; and (iii) ensure the beneficial owner is disclosed under the CRS/AEOI framework, as Vanuatu automatically exchanges financial information with 58+ jurisdictions through the Registered Agent.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Statutory rates 0% on cross-border royalties and interest (no domestic withholding law). No reduced treaty rates exist because no DTA network exists. Caution: licensing of the 'solar portable power' brand or intellectual property to a related party and the Affirm BNPL financing receivables may be recharacterised as 'Intellectual Property Business' or 'Financing and Leasing Business' under the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2020, triggering economic-substance reporting and foreign jurisdiction anti-hybrid rules.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: No statutory transfer-pricing, Local File, Master File, or CbC reporting regime exists in Vanuatu, and no VUV revenue threshold is prescribed. The absence of transfer-pricing rules creates residual BEPS risk: foreign tax authorities (e.g., China on the supplier side or the U.S. on the reseller side) may apply their own TP/CbC legislation to the pricing of solar equipment purchases and the zero-tax IC margin.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Applicable - the International Companies (Economic Substance) Act 2020 (No. 33 of 2020), enacted in response to the EU listing and OECD/Global Forum reviews, imposes mandatory substance requirements on ICs carrying on 'relevant activities', including 'Distribution and Service Centre Business' (purchasing portable power units from manufacturers and reselling them to customers), 'Intellectual Property Business' (brand licensing), and 'Financing and Leasing Business' (BNPL instalment receivables). The IC must maintain a registered office and physical presence in Vanuatu, hold board meetings with local strategic management in Vanuatu, employ an adequate number of full-time staff, and incur sufficient local operating expenditure. An annual economic substance notification/report must be filed through the Registered Agent. A zero-presence online retail IC is indistinguishable from a shell company and will fail substance assessment; this is the single most important compliance vulnerability for the structure.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion via Misuse of Tax-Exempt IC Status
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Carrying on a Vanuatu domestic online retail business - accepting orders from Vanuatu residents, holding inventory or operating a drop-ship hub in Vanuatu, or earning Vanuatu-source income - while failing to incorporate a local company, obtain a Business Licence, and charge 13% VAT; concurrently filing a false 'non-local business' declaration with the VFSC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Immediate loss of the Section 128 tax exemption; compulsory conversion to a Vanuatu local company; fine up to VUV 1,000,000 under the International Companies Act [Cap 222] and the Business Licence Act; restitution of forgone VAT and licence fees; deregistration of the IC.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors and the beneficial owner are personally liable for unpaid VAT, business licence fees, and penalties once the corporate veil is pierced for fraud; criminal prosecution under the Penal Code [Cap 135] for fraud, forgery, and perjury; travel bans and asset-freezing orders are available and routinely used.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Declaring a nil economic-substance position while actually conducting a distribution and service-centre business (purchasing solar generators/panels from offshore suppliers and reselling at a distance), or failing to submit the annual economic substance notification and supporting substance file through the Registered Agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Economic Substance Act administrative penalties ranging from VUV 100,000 to VUV 1,000,000; compulsory strike-off; adverse exchange of information with foreign tax authorities (CRS/AEOI); reinclusion of Vanuatu on the EU blacklist, jeopardising the entire jurisdiction's offshore regime.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Civil fines assessed jointly and severally against every director; personal liability for knowing misrepresentation; disqualification orders prohibiting management of any Vanuatu company for up to 10 years; removal from the VFSC register of approved persons.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing illicit card payments or BNPL proceeds through Stripe or Affirm that originate from sanctioned persons, chargeback fraud rings, the financing of terrorism, or money laundering; failing to maintain accurate beneficial-ownership registers and failing to report suspicious transactions through the Registered Agent under the Anti-Money Laundering and Counter-Terrorism Financing Act [Cap 155].
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Confiscation of proceeds under the Proceeds of Crime Act 2002; money-laundering conviction under the Penal Code [Cap 135]: imprisonment up to 20 years and substantial fines; regulatory monetary penalties up to VUV 10,000,000 under the AML/CTF Act [Cap 155]; revocation of the Registered Agent's licence.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Direct criminal liability for directing, financing, or concealing the offence; international travel bans and INTERPOL red notices; extradition to the requesting state; criminal-asset confiscation extending to personal property and foreign bank accounts.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Fraudulent Misrepresentation to VFSC and False Filings
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Providing false statements to the VFSC or the Commissioner of Inland Revenue: nominee concealment of the true beneficial owner, forged director signatures, fictitious local board minutes, backdated supply contracts, or concealment of foreign bank accounts connected to the online retail business.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Prosecution for perjury and forgery under the Penal Code [Cap 135]; VFSC cancellation of the IC's registration without a restoration right; monetary penalties up to VUV 1,000,000 against the company and each complicit agent.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Imprisonment up to 7 years for each officer who signs a knowingly false document; restitution orders for all profits derived from the misrepresentation; prohibition orders barring re-incorporation in Vanuatu; civil liability to creditors and minority shareholders for misrepresentation.
